body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 2-unit line or cluster of allies within 5 units. Enemies adjacent to at least two of them suffer -1 Defense until your next turn.

surges.html: One affected ally gains +1 Defense until the start of your next turn.
Remove Dazed, Concussed, or Shocked from one affected ally.

rider.title: FORMATION — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority when an enemy enters a space adjacent to two of your allies: 1–3 it suffers -1 Defense; 4–5 it becomes Exposed; 6+ it becomes Exposed and burns 1 die.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
